property_summary: For any callee address, calling c.forward(callee, data) returns (does not revert) whenever the low-level call to callee succeeds; the mutant forces a revert after a successful call so there exist inputs (a callee that succeeds) where forward reverts while reference does not.
change_summary: Insert an explicit revert() after the call so forward always reverts regardless of call success, making calls that previously succeeded now revert.
